title: A Morning by the Reed Beds
transcript: Before we set off on this morning's wildlife walk, make sure you've got a route card. You can pick one up from the wooden box beside the gate. The path divides fairly early on, and we'll take the branch that crosses the footbridge. It can be a bit slippery, so leave enough room for the person ahead of you. On the far side, we'll pass the reed beds and stop at the viewing screen. There are openings at different heights, so younger visitors should have a clear view too. We sometimes spend a while looking for birds there, but today I'd like us to pause first and listen for frogs. On the way back, we'll pass a small pond. Please leave any animal tracks you spot by the water undisturbed, so the Sunday group can see them as well.

questions.prompt: Route card container by the gate: wooden ____
questions.explanation: 路线卡放在大门旁边的木箱里。

questions.prompt: Crossing on the chosen branch of the path: ____
questions.explanation: 小路分岔后，队伍会走经过步行桥的那一条。

questions.prompt: Observation stop beyond the reed beds: viewing ____
questions.explanation: 队伍经过芦苇丛后会在观景屏处停下。

questions.prompt: What will the group do first at the observation stop?
options: Look for birds in the reeds.
questions.explanation: 带队人希望大家到达观察点后先停下来听蛙叫。

questions.prompt: What are walkers asked to do if they find tracks by the pond?
options: Mark the spot with a stick.
Tell the guide before moving on.
Leave the tracks as they are.
questions.answer: Leave the tracks as they are.
questions.explanation: 带队人请大家保留水边的动物足迹，让周日的队伍也能看到。
